text: Ah sorry this is probably a silly one but I'm up anyway so I thought I'd ask. My lad is 2 and his eczema is after flaring up something awful the last day or so, dry itchy patches on his arms and round his ankles and he won't leave them alone. He's had a few runny poos as well since yesterday, I think maybe 3 or 4 today, not sure if its something he ate. He's drinking grand though, he'd drink the house dry, and his nappies are wet as normal, so no bother there. Temp was 37.6 when I checked it earlier, I'd say thats not really a fever is it? He's in good form like, giving out to his sister and all. I just wasn't sure if the eczema and the tummy thing could be connected or if I'm overthinking it. I've been using his usual cream on him but it doesn't seem to be doing much. Sorry for the long message, I'd just rather ask than lie awake wondering
